company.name: ContraForce
company.shortDescription: ContraForce creating a secure future where service providers are the leading force against the global cybercrime epidemic.
company.description:
ContraForce is creating a secure future where service providers are the leading force against the global cybercrime epidemic. The company was founded in 2021 by Stan Golubchik and Ricky Melendez to revolutionize security service delivery, with the ultimate goal to make effective security services accessible to all.

ContraForce has gained worldwide attention for a series of 2024 milestones. It won the Microsoft Security Excellence Award for ISV of the year. The company launched Spark, a cloud-deployed workbench bringing MSSPs, MSPs, and Customers to collaborate together on security service delivery in one place. Additionally, Storm, a co-managed outsourced service connected MSPs and Customers to global MSSPs to jointly defend against cybercrime - a challenging feat previously only accomplished by MDR providers who outsourced security service delivery to themselves. Since then, ContraForce has connected service providers and customers globally to make effective security services accessible.

For more information, visit www.contraforce.com.
